<p id="random-status">Taking you to a random model...</p>

<noscript><p>This page needs JavaScript to pick a model. You can <a href="index.html#all-models">browse all models</a> instead.</p></noscript>

```{=html}
<script>
// Pick a random model from the index generated by Quarto (listings.json lists
// every page in the site's listings), so new models are included automatically.
const randomStatus = document.getElementById("random-status");
fetch("listings.json")
  .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
  .then(listings => {
    const items = new Set();
    listings.forEach(l => (l.items || []).forEach(i => { if (i.includes("/models/")) items.add(i); }));
    const all = [...items];
    if (!all.length) throw new Error("no models");
    window.location.replace(all[Math.floor(Math.random() * all.length)].replace(/^\//, ""));
  })
  .catch(() => {
    randomStatus.innerHTML = 'Sorry, a random model couldn\'t be picked. You can <a href="index.html#all-models">browse all models</a> instead.';
  });
</script>
```
